Neki ke liye qasd zaroori hai: Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Alqama Sham mein aaye aur Damishq ki masjid mein jakar do rakat namaz ada ki aur Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke Ilahi mujhe nek sathi ata farma, phir chale to Hazrat Abu Darda R.A se mulaqat hui, poocha ke tum kahan ke ho? To Hazrat Alqama ne kaha main Koofe wala hoon, poocha Umm-e-Abd (R.A) is surat ko kis tarah parhte thay? Main ne kaha "Wazzakari wal untha" parhte thay. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A farmane lage main ne bhi Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yunhi suna hai aur yeh log mujhe shak-o-shuba mein daal rahe hain. Phir farmaya kya tum mein takiye wale yani jin ke paas safar mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka bistara rehta tha aur raaz-daan, aise bhedon se waqif jin ka ilm aur kisi ko nahin, woh jo Shaitan se ba-zaban-e-Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bacha liye gaye thay woh nahin? Yani Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A. Yeh hadith Bukhari mein hai, is mein yeh hai ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ke shagird aur sathi Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ke paas aaye, aap bhi unhein dhoondte hue pohanchay, phir poocha ke tum mein Hazrat Abdullah R.A ki qirat par Quran parhne wala kaun hai? Kaha ke hum sab hain, phir poocha ke tum sab mein Hazrat Abdullah R.A ki qirat ko zyada yaad rakhne wala kaun hai? Logon ne Hazrat Alqama ki taraf ishara kiya, to un se sawal kiya ke "Wallaili iza yaghsha" ko Hazrat Abdullah R.A se tum ne kis tarah suna? To kaha woh "Wazzakari wal untha" parhte thay, kaha main ne bhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se isi tarah suna hai aur yeh log chahte hain ke main "Wama khalaqazzakara wal untha" parhoon, Allah ki qasam main to in ki manoon ga nahin. Al-gharaz Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A aur Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ki qirat yahi hai aur Hazrat Abu Darda R.A ne to isay marfoo bhi kaha hai. Baqi jamhoor ki qirat wahi hai jo mojooda Quranon mein hai. Pas Allah Ta'ala raat ki qasam khata hai jabke is ka andhera tamam makhlooq par chha jaye aur din ki qasam khata hai jabke woh tamam cheezon ko roshni se munawwar kar de aur apni zaat ki qasam khata hai jo nar-o-mada ka paida karne wala hai, jaise farmaya "Wa khalaqnakum azwaja" (hum ne tumhein jora jora paida kiya hai) aur farmaya "Wa kulli shai'in khalaqna zaujain" (hum ne har cheez ke joray paida kiye hain). In mutazad aur ek dusre ke khilaf qasmein khakar ab farmata hai ke tumhari koshishein aur tumhare aamal bhi mutazad aur ek dusre ke khilaf hain. Bhalai karne wale bhi hain aur buraiyon mein mubtala rehne wale bhi hain. Phir farmaya hai ke jis ne diya yani apne maal ko Allah ke hukm ke matahat kharch kiya aur phoonk phoonk kar qadam rakha, har ek amr mein khauf-e-Ilahi karta raha aur is ke badlay ko sacha janta raha, is ke sawab par yaqeen rakha. Husna ke ma'ani La Ilaha Illallah ke bhi kiye gaye hain.

Allah ki ne'maton ke bhi kiye gaye hain, namaz, zakat, sadqa-e-fitr, jannat ke bhi marwi hain phir farmaya hai ke hum aasani ki raah aasaan kar denge yani bhalai, jannat aur nek badle ki aur jis ne apne maal ko raah-e-Allah mein na diya aur Allah Ta'ala se be-niyazi barti aur husna ki yani qayamat ke badle ki takzeeb ki to us par hum burai ka raasta aasaan kar denge jaise farmaya wa nuqallibu af'idatahum wa absarahum al-kh, yani hum un ke dil aur un ki aankhein ulat denge jis tarah woh pehli baar Quran par iman na laye thay aur hum unhein un ki sarkashi mein hi behakne denge, is matlab ki aayatein Quran-e-Kareem ki jagah maujood hain ke har amal ka badla usi jaisa hota hai, khair ka qasd karne wale ko taufiq-e-khair milti hai aur shar ka qasd rakhne walon ko usi ki taufiq hoti hai. Is ma'ni ki ta'eed mein yeh hadeesein bhi hain, Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne ek martaba Rasool Allah ﷺ se sawal kiya ke hamare a'maal farigh shuda taqdeer ke matahat hain ya nau-paid hamari taraf se hain? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya balkay taqdeer ke likhe hue ke mutabiq, kehne lage phir amal ki kya zaroorat? Farmaya har shakhs par woh amal aasaan honge jis cheez ke liye woh paida kiya gaya hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain ke Baqi-e-Gharqad mein hum Rasool Allah ﷺ ke saath ek janaze mein thay to Aap ﷺ ne farmaya suno tum mein se har ek ki jagah jannat-o-dozakh mein muqarrar karda hai aur likhi hui hai, logon ne kaha phir hum is par bharosa kar ke baith kyun na rahein? To Aap ﷺ ne farmaya amal karte raho har shakhs se wahi a'maal sadir honge jin ke liye woh paida kiya gaya hai phir Aap ﷺ ne yahi aayatein tilawat farmayin (Sahih Bukhari Sharif). Isi riwayat ke aur tareeq mein hai ke is bayan ke waqt Aap ﷺ ke haath mein ek tinka tha aur sar neecha kiye hue zameen par use pher rahe thay. Alfaaz mein kuch kami beshi bhi hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar R.A ka bhi aisa hi sawal jaisa oopar ki hadees mein Hazrat Siddiq R.A ka guzra marwi hai aur Aap ﷺ ka jawab bhi taqreeban aisa hi marwi hai. Ibn-e-Jareer mein Hazrat Jabir R.A se bhi aisi hi riwayat marwi hai, Ibn-e-Jareer ki ek hadees mein do naujawanon ka aisa hi sawal aur Huzoor ﷺ ka aisa hi jawab marwi hai, aur phir un dono hazrat ka yeh qaul bhi hai ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ hum ba-koshish nek a'maal karte rahenge. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A se bhi isi tarah marwi hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain har din ghuroob ke waqt sooraj ke dono taraf do farishtay hote hain aur woh ba-aawaz-e-buland dua karte hain jise tamam cheezein sunti hain siwaye jinnat aur insaan ke ke Aye Allah sakhi ko nek badla de aur bakheel ka maal talaf kar, yahi ma'ni hain Quran ki in charon aayaton ke.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim ki aik bohat hi ghareeb hadith mein is poori Surah ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh likha hai ke aik shakhs ka khajooron ka baagh tha, un mein se aik darakht ki shakhein aik maskeen shakhs ke ghar mein ja kar wahan ki khajoorein utartin, is mein jo khajoorein neeche girtin unhein us ghareeb shakhs ke bache chun lete to yeh aa kar un se cheen leta, balkay agar kisi bache ne munh mein daal li hai to ungli daal kar us ke munh se nikalwa leta. Is maskeen ne is ki shikayat Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se ki. Aap (ﷺ) ne us se farma diya ke acha tum jao. Aur Aap (ﷺ) us baagh walay se mile aur farmaya ke tu apna woh darakht jis ki shakhein falan maskeen ke ghar mein hain mujhe de de, Allah Ta'ala is ke badle tujhe Jannat ka aik darakht de ga. Woh kehne laga acha Hazrat! main ne diya magar mujhe is ki khajoorein bohat achi lagti hain, mere tamam baagh mein aisi khajoorein kisi aur darakht ki nahin. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) yeh sun kar khamoshi ke sath wapas tashreef le gaye. Aik shakhs jo yeh baat-cheet sun raha tha woh Aap (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur kehne laga Hazrat! agar yeh darakht mera ho jaye aur main Aap (ﷺ) ka kar doon to kya mujhe is ke badle Jannati darakht mil sakta hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya haan. Yeh shakhs us baagh walay ke paas aaye, un ka bhi baagh khajooron ka tha. Yeh pehla shakhs un se woh zikr karne laga ke Hazrat (ﷺ) mujhe falan darakht khajoor ke badle Jannat ka aik darakht dene ko keh rahe thay. Main ne yeh jawab diya, yeh sun kar khamosh ho rahe. Phir thori der baad farmaya ke kya tum ise bechna chahte ho? Us ne kaha nahin. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke jo qeemat is ki mangoon woh koi mujhe de de. Lekin kaun de sakta hai? Poocha kya qeemat lena chahte ho? Kaha chalees darakht khurma ke. Us ne kaha yeh to bari zabardast qeemat laga rahe ho, aik ke chalees? Phir aur baton mein lag gaye, phir kehne lage acha main ise itne hi mein khareedta hoon. Us ne kaha acha agar sach-much khareedna hai to gawah kar lo. Us ne chand logon ko bula liya aur mamla tay ho gaya, gawah muqarrar ho gaye. Phir use kuch soojhi to kehne laga ke dekhiye sahib! jab tak hum tum alag nahin hue yeh mamla tay nahin hua. Us ne bhi kaha bohat acha, main bhi aisa ahmaq nahin hoon ke tere aik darakht ke badle jo kham khaya hua hai apne chalees darakht de doon. To yeh kehne laga ke acha acha mujhe manzoor hai. Lekin darakht jo main loon ga woh tane wale bohat umda loon ga. Us ne kaha acha manzoor. Chunancha gawahon ke rubaru yeh sauda faisal hua aur majlis barkhast hui. Yeh shakhs khushi khushi Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! ab woh darakht mera ho gaya aur main ne ise Aap (ﷺ) ko de diya. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us maskeen ke paas gaye aur farmane lage, yeh darakht tumhara hai aur tumhare baal-bachon ka. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain is par yeh Surah nazil hui. Ibn-e-Jareer mein marwi hai ke yeh aayatein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hain.

To Siddiq-e-Akbar R.A ne jawab diya ke abba ji mera irada deenwi faide ka nahin main to sirf raza-e-Rabb aur marzi-e-Maula chahta hoon. Is bare mein yeh ayat nazil huin. Ibn-e-Jareer mein marwi hai ke yeh aayatein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui hain.

Tarwi ke ma'ani marne ke bhi marwi hain aur aag mein girne ke bhi.

Momin ki manzil Allah Ta'ala ki raza: Ya'ni halal-o-haram ka zahir kardena hamare zimme hai, yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke jo hidayat par chala woh yaqeenan hum tak pahunch jayega, jaise farmaya Wa-Alallahi Qasd-us-Sabeel. Aakhirat aur duniya ki malkiyat hamari hi hai. Main ne bhadakti hui aag se tumhein hoshiyar kardiya hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Nu'man bin Bashir (R.A) ne apne khutbe mein farmaya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne khutbe ki halat mein suna hai, aap bahut buland aawaz se farma rahe the yahan tak ke meri is jagah se bazaar tak aawaz pahunche aur baar baar farmate jate the: Logo! Main tumhein jahannam ki aag se dara chuka. Logo! Main tumhein jahannam ki aag se dara raha hoon, baar baar yeh farma rahe the yahan tak ke chadar-e-mubarak kandhon se sarak kar pairon mein gir padi. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Sab se halke azab wala jahannami qayamat ke din woh hoga jis ke dono qadmon tale do angare rakh diye jayenge jis se us ka dimagh ubal raha ho. Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai: Halke azab wala woh jahannami hoga jis ki dono jotiyan aur dono tasme aag ke honge jin se us ka dimagh is tarah ubal raha hoga jis tarah handiya josh kha rahi ho, bawajood yeh ke sab se halke azab wala yahi hai lekin us ke khayal mein is se zyada azab wala aur koi na hoga. Is jahannam mein sirf wahi log gher-ghaar kar badtareen azab kiye jayenge jo badbakht-tar hon, jin ke dilon mein kizb-o-ba'z ho aur Islam par amal na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein bhi hai ke jahannam mein sirf shaqi log jayenge. Logon ne poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya: Jo ita'at-guzar na hon aur na Allah ke khauf se koi badi chhodta ho. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai: Meri sari ummat jannat mein jayegi siwaye us ke jo jannat mein jaane se inkar kare. Logon ne poocha jannat mein jaane se inkar karne wala kaun hai? Farmaya: Jo meri ita'at kare woh jannat mein gaya aur jis ne meri nafarmani ki us ne goya jannat mein jaane se inkar kardiya. Aur farmaya: Jahannam se doori use hogi jo taqwa-sha'ar, parhezgar aur Allah ke dar wala hoga, jo apne maal ko Allah ki raah mein de taake khud bhi paak hojaye aur apni cheezon ko bhi paak karle aur deen-o-duniya mein pakeezgi hasil karle, kyunke yeh shakhs is liye kisi ke sath sulook nahin karta ke us ka koi ehsan us par hai, balki is liye ke aakhirat mein jannat mile aur wahan Allah ka deedar naseeb ho. Phir farmata hai ke bahut jald bil-yaqeen aisi paak sifaton wala shakhs raazi hojayega. Aksar mufassireen kehte hain yeh aayatein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke bare mein utri hain, yahan tak ke ba'z mufassireen ne to is par ijma naqal kiya hai. Beshak Siddiq-e-Akbar is mein dakhil hain aur is ki umoomiyat mein sari ummat se pehle hain, go alfaaz-e-aayat ke aam hain lekin aap se awwal is ke misdaq hain. In tamam ausaf mein aur kul ki kul nekiyon mein sab se pehle aur sab se aage aur sab se badhe chadhay hue aap hi the, aap Siddiq the, parhezgar the, buzurg the, sakhi the.

Aap maalon ko apne Maula ki ita'at mein aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki imdad mein dil khol kar kharch karte rehte the. Har ek ke sath ehsan-o-sulook karte aur kisi dunyawi faide ki chahat par nahin, kisi ke ehsan ke badle nahin, balkeh sirf Allah ki marzi ke liye, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari ke liye. Jitne log the khwah bade hon khwah chhote, sab par Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ke ehsanat ke baar the. Yahan tak ke Urwa bin Masood jo qabeela Saqeef ka sardar tha, Sulh-e-Hudaibiya ke mauqa par jabkeh Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne use danta dipta aur do baatein sunayin to usne kaha ke agar aap ke ehsan mujh par na hote jiska badla main nahin de saka to main aap ko zaroor jawab deta. Pas jabkeh Arab ke sardar aur qabail-e-Arab ke badshah ke oopar aap ke is qadar ehsan the ke woh sar nahin utha sakta tha to bhala aur to kahan? Isi liye yahan bhi farmaya gaya ke kisi par ehsan ka badla unhein dena nahin balkeh sirf deedar-e-Allah ki khwahish hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai jo shakhs joda Allah ki rah mein kharch kare use jannat ke daroghe pukarenge ke ae Allah ke bande idhar se aao yeh sab se achha hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan hai aur mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke tum un mein se ho. Alhamdulillah Surah Al-Lail ki tafsir khatam hui. Allah ka ehsan hai aur uska shukar hai.

To Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne farmaya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Koi zaroorat to aisi nahin lekin farmayiye to kya koi aisa bhi hai jo jannat ke tamam darwazon se bulaya jaye? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan hai aur mujhe Allah se umeed hai ke tum un mein se ho. Alhamdulillah Surah Al-Lail ki tafsir khatam hui. Allah ka ehsan hai aur uska shukar hai.

Momin ki manzil Allah Ta'ala ki raza: Ya'ni halal-o-haram ka zahir kardena hamare zimme hai, yeh bhi ma'ani hain ke jo hidayat par chala woh yaqeenan hum tak pahunch jayega, jaise farmaya Wa-Alallahi Qasd-us-Sabeel. Aakhirat aur duniya ki malkiyat hamari hi hai. Main ne bhadakti hui aag se tumhein hoshiyar kardiya hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Nu'man bin Bashir (R.A) ne apne khutbe mein farmaya ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se main ne khutbe ki halat mein suna hai, aap bahut buland aawaz se farma rahe the yahan tak ke meri is jagah se bazaar tak aawaz pahunche aur baar baar farmate jate the: Logo! Main tumhein jahannam ki aag se dara chuka. Logo! Main tumhein jahannam ki aag se dara raha hoon, baar baar yeh farma rahe the yahan tak ke chadar-e-mubarak kandhon se sarak kar pairon mein gir padi. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Sab se halke azab wala jahannami qayamat ke din woh hoga jis ke dono qadmon tale do angare rakh diye jayenge jis se us ka dimagh ubal raha ho. Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai: Halke azab wala woh jahannami hoga jis ki dono jotiyan aur dono tasme aag ke honge jin se us ka dimagh is tarah ubal raha hoga jis tarah handiya josh kha rahi ho, bawajood yeh ke sab se halke azab wala yahi hai lekin us ke khayal mein is se zyada azab wala aur koi na hoga. Is jahannam mein sirf wahi log gher-ghaar kar badtareen azab kiye jayenge jo badbakht-tar hon, jin ke dilon mein kizb-o-ba'z ho aur Islam par amal na ho. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein bhi hai ke jahannam mein sirf shaqi log jayenge. Logon ne poocha woh kaun hain? Farmaya: Jo ita'at-guzar na hon aur na Allah ke khauf se koi badi chhodta ho. Musnad ki aur hadith mein hai: Meri sari ummat jannat mein jayegi siwaye us ke jo jannat mein jaane se inkar kare. Logon ne poocha jannat mein jaane se inkar karne wala kaun hai? Farmaya: Jo meri ita'at kare woh jannat mein gaya aur jis ne meri nafarmani ki us ne goya jannat mein jaane se inkar kardiya. Aur farmaya: Jahannam se doori use hogi jo taqwa-sha'ar, parhezgar aur Allah ke dar wala hoga, jo apne maal ko Allah ki raah mein de taake khud bhi paak hojaye aur apni cheezon ko bhi paak karle aur deen-o-duniya mein pakeezgi hasil karle, kyunke yeh shakhs is liye kisi ke sath sulook nahin karta ke us ka koi ehsan us par hai, balki is liye ke aakhirat mein jannat mile aur wahan Allah ka deedar naseeb ho. Phir farmata hai ke bahut jald bil-yaqeen aisi paak sifaton wala shakhs raazi hojayega. Aksar mufassireen kehte hain yeh aayatein Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) ke bare mein utri hain, yahan tak ke ba'z mufassireen ne to is par ijma naqal kiya hai. Beshak Siddiq-e-Akbar is mein dakhil hain aur is ki umoomiyat mein sari ummat se pehle hain, go alfaaz-e-aayat ke aam hain lekin aap se awwal is ke misdaq hain. In tamam ausaf mein aur kul ki kul nekiyon mein sab se pehle aur sab se aage aur sab se badhe chadhay hue aap hi the, aap Siddiq the, parhezgar the, buzurg the, sakhi the.

Aap maalon ko apne Maula ki ita'at mein aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki imdad mein dil khol kar kharch karte rehte the. Har ek ke sath ehsan-o-sulook karte aur kisi dunyawi faide ki chahat par nahin, kisi ke ehsan ke badle nahin, balkeh sirf Allah ki marzi ke liye, Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki farmanbardari ke liye. Jitne log the khwah bade hon khwah chhote, sab par Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar (R.A) ke ehsanat ke baar the. Yahan tak ke Urwa bin Masood jo qabeela Saqeef ka sardar tha, Sulh-e-Hudaibiya ke mauqa par jabkeh Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne use danta dipta aur do baatein sunayin to usne kaha ke agar aap ke ehsan mujh par na hote jiska badla main nahin de saka to main aap ko zaroor jawab deta. Pas jabkeh Arab ke sardar aur qabail-e-Arab ke badshah ke oopar aap ke is qadar ehsan the ke woh sar nahin utha sakta tha to bhala aur to kahan?
